unit_scope: Raw decoded displacement-value units only; no independent SI/metre/physical significance acceptance.
ULP_definition: Interpret each raw LE word as uint64 u. Let magnitude=u & (2^63-1). rank=2^63-magnitude for negative sign, 2^63+magnitude otherwise. Distance=abs(rank(a)-rank(b)); signed zero ranks collapse, with zero-sign differences classified separately. This counts ordered finite binary64 steps; it is not a tolerance or physical error.
absolute_difference_definition: Exact Fraction.from_float(Exodus)-Fraction.from_float(X1) after unpacking only saved report LE words. Fractions and finite dyadic decimal strings are exact. approximate_decimal is display only.
field_origin_limits: Allthree views share the solver pipeline; equality/differences classify internal saved storage only.
